snippet.title: Below, Rusted Gods – New Official Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Wishlist now on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2895680

Try the demo:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3243360/Below_Rusted_Gods_Demo/

BELOW RUSTED GODS
A narrative-driven horror game where you are the lifeline supporting an expedition into the unknown. Keep both yourself and your squad alive by interpreting instrument readings, explore the facilities, and uncover something ancient and eager to be born.

Reach us out at: info@fromsouthgames.com

Join our discord: https://discord.gg/yNchrt4gpE

Our previous title, A Top-Down Cyberpunk shooter - Esse Proxy: https://store.steampowered.com/app/1485070/Esse_Proxy/
